subject: Pocketcard story assets and Acme case bullets
messages:
From: Julia Ramos <julia@eventworks.co>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Booth assets package — pocketcard + checklist

Hi Naomi,

Attached is the initial asset pack for the Summit booth: event_asset_checklist.xlsx and a booth-pocketcard-draft.pdf that our designer knocked up. We focused the pocketcard on a single narrative: 'Predictable inference economics at scale' with a short bullet of features and a CTA to schedule a follow-up.

Before we send to print, can your team confirm the required logo lockups, short speaker intro (1 line), and whether you want a quick case highlight on the reverse? Emily from Acme mentioned they'd be open to a short case blurb if Redwoods can provide one.

I can push a revised PDF by EOD if you have specific edits.

Cheers,
Julia
EventWorks

Attachments: event_asset_checklist.xlsx, booth-pocketcard-draft.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Julia Ramos <julia@eventworks.co>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 25 Apr 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Booth assets package — pocketcard + checklist

Hi Julia — thanks for the packet and quick turnaround. A few asks / edits from our side so the pocketcard and reverse case will map to our messaging and legal: 

- Can you shorten the headline to: "Inference that scales — predictable cost, lower latency" (we'll adjust type size).
- We want the reverse to be a tiny 'Case highlight' (3 bullets) for Acme Retail: outcome, metric, what we did. I'll drop suggested bullets below.
- Please include SVG and white/black logo variants; we prefer the horizontal lockup for print.
- Speaker one-liner (for the booth rep): "Naomi Feldman — Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference — I help teams ship inference at lower cost and latency."
- Demo ask: we need a 3-minute demo script (talk-through + live prompt) for the booth loop. Marcus, can you draft 2 alternate 3-min snippets?

I've attached our internal pocketcard guidance (redwood_pocketcard_guidelines.pdf) with bleed/trim specs. Also note legal wants the phrase 'results based on customer deployment; individual results may vary' as a small footer if we include metrics.

Suggested Acme case bullets (first pass):
1) Reduced per-token cost by ~40% via batching + quantization on Dedicated pools.
2) 2–5x throughput increase on peak shopping windows, enabling personalized offers.
3) Deployed in VPC for PII controls; no customer data left the customer's environment.

Can you push updated art with those copy swaps? We need a print-proof by Tue for vendor cutoff.

Thanks — Naomi
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_pocketcard_guidelines.pdf

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Julia Ramos <julia@eventworks.co>
Date: Sat, 25 Apr 2026 13:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Booth assets package — pocketcard + checklist

Looping in my suggested demo snippets and a tiny script for the 3-minute booth loop. Quick notes inline: 

- For the demo script: lead with the customer problem (latency spikes + cost leakage), show a 30s stream of a prompt so attendees see token pacing, then call out the cost delta as a single stat. Avoid heavy infrastructure slides.
- On the Acme bullets: swap the order to lead with the customer outcome (personalization uplift) then show the cost % as supporting proof.

I attached demo-snippets-v2.docx with two alternatives: 
A) Live prompt walk-through (interactive) — good if we have the rep on a reliable network.
B) Recorded loop + timed voiceover — fallback if connectivity is flaky.

Also note: consider a small QR on the pocketcard linking to the full case study (hosted on our site) — helps keep copy tiny.

—Marcus
Product Marketing
Redwood Inference

Attachment: demo-snippets-v2.docx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Julia Ramos <julia@eventworks.co>
Date: Sun, 26 Apr 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Booth assets package — pocketcard + checklist

Thanks team — a couple of quick slide/print notes from design ops: 

- Replace the third technical bullet with a single line: "Runs in hosted, dedicated, or private deployments — same API, measurable unit economics." It's clearer at a glance on a pocketcard.
- Use the legal footer Naomi mentioned; set type to 6.5 pt.
- For the Acme case, lean on outcome-first language: 
  • Personalization conversions +12% (Q4 pilot) 
  • 40% lower per-token processing cost on peak windows
  • VPC deployment with SOC2 controls in place

Attached are slide-notes_v1.pptx with an example speaker cue for the 90s live demo and a print PDF mockup for the pocketcard layout.

I'll also coordinate with Ops to confirm print specs (coated stock, 2-up layout). Naomi — please confirm final approval and whether we include the QR to the full case.

Laura Bennett
Design Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: slide-notes_v1.pptx

From: Julia Ramos <julia@eventworks.co>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Booth assets package — pocketcard + checklist

Hi all — thanks for the clarifying notes. Per Naomi/Laura/Marcus: attached are the revised files for print and review — pocketcard_final.pdf, and the Acme case bullets as acme_case_bullets.docx. 

What I updated:
- Headline shortened and lockup switched to horizontal SVGs included in the file.
- Footer legal line added in 6.5pt.
- Acme case uses outcome-first bullets and includes a short URL for the full case study.
- Added a small QR target zone (quiet area respected) on the reverse.

Next steps:
- Naomi: confirm final approval by Tue EOD so we can confirm print run (vendor needs press-ready PDF by Wed noon).
- Marcus: pick the demo snippet A or B and I'll export a looped MP4 for the booth screen if you want the recorded fallback.

Emily from Acme is looped in for visibility; she said the numbers look fine to include as a pilot quote.

Cheers,
Julia Ramos
EventWorks

Attachments: pocketcard_final.pdf, acme_case_bullets.docx
